newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - India hardly changed, Taiwan down.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - India hardly changed, Taiwan down.

text.p: Indian global depository receipts (GDRs) were hardly changed in dull trade on Friday amid a lack of fresh factors and little change in Bombay.
Traders said the market had paused ahead of the weekend following a strong showing on Thursday, and underlying sentiment remained positive.
They said the market was slow ahead of a GDR issue by telecoms group VSNL, which should be priced early in the week.
The issue is expected to raise about $550 million.
The Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index dipped 1.85 points to 3,730.20.
Reliance added 22 cents to $18.15/18.90, and Bajaj shed 50 cents to $36.75/37.75 following strong gains on Thursday.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index added 0.06 percent by the close at 74.85, while the premium rose to 17.67 percent from 17.05 percent.
In other Asian markets, the Capel Taiwan GDR Index dived 7.18 points 111.66 following sharp losses in the local market. The discount to the local market was 1.62 percent.
The Capel Korea GDR Index ended 1.52 points lower at 54.12, while the premium fell to 33.26 percent.
